symptom: A cloud workspace became usable 6-7 s after its worker said hello. The relay noticed `running` only by polling every ~2 s, with a full authority read per loop. It then re-read authority three more times and rebuilt configuration with uncached source checks.
rule: Readiness is pushed as a commit-time hint that carries no authority, with polling as the fallback. The relay's own re-checks share the bounded, revision-fenced authority window. A source continuation reuses its lease only with a proof from that fresh room read (principles 4, 9, 11).
